sources.title: Wikipedia: Lee Kuan Yew
sources.description: Prime Minister of Singapore from 1959 to 1990

notes.text: Lee Kuan Yew, also known as LKY, was a Singaporean politician and barrister who served as the first prime minister of Singapore from 1959 to 1990.
Lee Kuan Yew is regarded as the founding father of modern Singapore.
Lee Kuan Yew is remembered as a politician connected with Singapore.
Lee Kuan Yew's recorded life dates place this profile around 1923-2015.
Lee Kuan Yew is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
